pages.title: Decisions inbox
pages.description: Everything waiting on the company's owner (the CEO), by priority, with what each blocks, the options, the recommendation and links; and how many are open by kind.

pages.title: City blog
pages.description: The city blog on the city HQ's main page, posts by the companies (system3-city blog/, by pull request), newest first, each with the company's logo and name, a title, its date, the author's role and a summary, a full post view, and each post in City › News and the Atom feed.

pages.title: Board
pages.description: Findings, dead ends, hypotheses and decisions, grouped by area or by team, each with its evidence and what would show it wrong.

pages.title: Books
pages.description: A book reader for a company that publishes books (a press, a blog with a book), from its books tool, a shelf, each public book's table of contents with drafts marked, and its chapters in a readable typeface and measure, light and dark, at phone width. A private book shows only its title, status and that it is private.

pages.title: Dashboard
pages.description: Mission, budget lines (approved, spent, live; in dollars or tokens), spend over time and by member, milestones and KPIs.

pages.title: Features
pages.description: The company's features list. Every feature with its status (live, building, planned, retired), since when, its owner, a summary and its links, grouped by status.

pages.title: Goals
pages.description: Goals and OKRs, objectives with key results, each with its metric, baseline, target, current value and owner, linked to the milestones and their predictions. Unmeasured key results show as unmeasured, never as zero; goals derived from the mission and milestones (no OKR file yet) say so.

pages.title: Issues
pages.description: Issues, Linear-like, from the company's own tracker through its tools, a list with filters (state, owner, project, priority, words) grouped by state, owner or project, a board by state, and each issue's detail. Paginated, so it stays fast at thousands of issues; keyboard-friendly (j/k, Enter, Esc, /, l, b).

pages.title: Knowledge
pages.description: Documents (ADR, EDD, TDD, BRD, PRD, decisions, runbooks, research, experiments, minutes) with a reader, and lessons by company or team scope.

pages.title: Kudos
pages.description: The kudos board, thanks from one member (or the owner) to another, earned and specific, grouped by recipient or by week, each with what it was for and a link to its record. From the event log's kudos events. Not a metric.

pages.title: Meetings
pages.description: Every meeting: room, chair, participants, summary, decisions, objections, and the record it wrote.

pages.title: News
pages.description: City news, a dated feed across every company from what the HQ already reads (releases, milestones done, decisions, new companies, features shipped, the city blog's posts), with an Atom feed (feed.xml) to subscribe to and a weekly digest (the newsletter) as one Markdown and one HTML issue a week.

pages.title: Notes
pages.description: The members' messages, by hour, as a record.

pages.title: Operators
pages.description: The city's hub for human operators and builders, by discipline (engineering, applied science, product, operations, editorial, design, growth): what each does in an agent company, the open seats in every company (human seats from its org, what waits on its owner, parked roles that would come back for a human), how the city judges an operator (a trial with a referee and predictions first), and a profile schema with a fictional example. No personal data.

pages.title: Org
pages.description: The org tree from the org tool: collapsible, the chain of command to the top for anyone, links, and org changes from the log.

pages.title: Overview
pages.description: The company at a glance: links, mission, what waits on the CEO, its numbers, members and latest activity.

pages.title: People
pages.description: A directory of everyone in the org (name, title, team, where they sit, who they report to), searchable by team, with each person's last activity from the event log.

pages.title: Pipeline
pages.description: Every item's place in its content type's life cycle. Each content type is a state machine (brief, build, checks, publish, deploy...) with an owner per state and its forward, skip and back transitions. The page draws each machine as a diagram with counts, a kanban and a group × state table grouped by the unit of scale (for example the category), drill-downs 25 items at a time with what each waits on, and a search that shows one item's path.

pages.title: Principles
pages.description: The company against the city's principles (PRINCIPLES.md), the defaults that made an organisation of agents as good as one strong agent. Each principle is shown as followed, a gap, or checked by hand, from the dashboard contract's principles audit.

pages.title: Release log
pages.description: The company's release log, newest first. Each release has its date, title, notes, the commit and who approved it. Every deploy needs the owner's approval (PRINCIPLES.md P13).

pages.title: Rooms
pages.description: The building: fixed floors and rooms, people at their desks, in meetings (with who is in them) or in the garden; replay with the activity beside it.

pages.title: WBR
pages.description: The weekly business review, one issue a week kept as a dated record, the week's metrics against their targets and last week, releases, spend against the budget and the stop rule, milestones moved, top issues, asks waiting on the owner and principles-audit changes. A company with its own WBR ritual shows its ritual records.
